policy.primaryModernTarget: Drik Panchang published location-specific Tara Asta/Udaya boundaries

policy.scientificCrossCheck: Independent modern ephemerides and observer-geometry calculations; never treated as a substitute for published Panchang acceptance
policy.classicalMethods: Out of scope for production Asta/Udaya; preserve historical Surya Siddhanta research only as a separate archive
policy.comparisonRule: Never average event times from different definitions, locations, coordinate frames, or visibility models.
policy.unknownValues: Keep null or omit; never fill by inference.
policy.locationComparison: Every benchmark case is scoped to one named source location. Never compare or average across locations. If provider coordinates are undisclosed, label the case city-level-only and do not claim coordinate-exact validation.
policy.acceptanceRule: Production acceptance is based on same-city published Panchang event boundaries and declared tolerances. No arbitrary threshold fitting.
